rules.statement: A sale having duly taken place in execution of a decree valid at the time cannot afterwards be set aside as against a bona fide purchaser not a party to the decree, on the ground that the decree had been, subsequently to the sale, reversed.
rules.supporting_quote: It was there held that a sale, having duly taken place in execution of a decree valid at the time, cannot afterwards be set aside as against a bona fide purchaser, not a party to the decree, on the ground that the decree had been, subsequently to the sale, reversed.
